explanations: The cancel / reassign rule allows any user whose role is "admin", but roles are scoped to the user's own organization, and the check never asks which organization the admin belongs to. Unrelated companies are still turned away because the service first requires "view" access. A carrier's admin can see the shipment, though, so they pass the view check and then get shipper-only powers. The fix requires isShipper for both roles, so only the shipper's admins and dispatchers can cancel a shipment or change its carrier.
